policy: Task stages describe this workstream deliverable, not overall game acceptance. Art-only tasks may be tested as assets but require integration and rendered acceptance before visual acceptance. Existing code-only verification remains open. Dependencies are ready at tested, visually verified or accepted stage; final acceptance requires the controlling release gates. Browser is conservatively a shared resource, not a guarantee of available slots. Keep unless a demonstrated defect, unmet mandatory product outcome or validated player-experience issue warrants a change. Verify existing work first; do not invent new work solely to increase progress counts. Optional refinements should not delay release after required gates pass. Manual continue/resume/proceed targets as many genuinely completed outstanding workstream deliverables as the session permits, without a fixed batch cap. Automatically proceed after each committed completion until all actionable work is done or an actual session/tool limit is reached. Select finishable release-critical work; verify full implementation scope before promoting stage, preserve separate visual and final acceptance gates, skip genuinely blocked tasks, and report actual clears and remaining count.
